mapper.select: SELECT id, title, artist, album, genre, release_year, created_at FROM music ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT id, title, artist, album, genre, release_year, created_at FROM music WHERE title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR artist LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR album LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR genre LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY id DESC
